issues.title: feat(cli): Add built-in 'verscript update' self-updating binary command
issues.body:
## Summary
Added `verscript update` command into the CLI binary. Checks GitHub Releases API for new updates, downloads the latest release archive, and unpacks to the user's LocalAppData runtime directory.

issues.title: feat(compiler): Add 'step' keyword for customizable loop strides
issues.body:
## Summary
Implemented the `step` keyword to control step increments in `for ... in ...` range loops.

### Syntax
```verscript
for i in 0 .. 10 step 2:
    display i
```

### Testing
Added test case in `tests/test_step.vrs` and verified with GCC compiler.

issues.title: feat(concurrency): Implement channel select and non-blocking receive syntax
issues.body:

VerScript currently supports `chan<type>` and `send`/`receive`, but waiting across multiple channels simultaneously requires busy polling.

Introduce `select` statement to wait on multiple channel operations simultaneously:
